doubts.claim_under_doubt: diff_sha256 is checked against an INDEPENDENTLY recomputed hash
doubts.disproof_attempt: The test's _diff_sha256 reuses the exact same git diff + raw-bytes sha256 steps review_attribution.py::pin itself takes -- it can only catch a payload-field mismatch, never a bug shared by both sides of the same computation.
doubts.resolution: accepted-and-fixed: comment now states this proves internal payload consistency, not independent hash re-derivation.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: _merge_to_origin_default faithfully plays gh pr merge --squash for cmd_mark_merged's ancestry check
doubts.disproof_attempt: A --no-ff merge produces a 2-parent commit a real squash never would. Today's ancestry check is insensitive to this (it checks the post-merge SHA itself, not branch-tip ancestry), but a future parent-shape-sensitive check would silently pass here where a real squash would fail.
doubts.resolution: accepted-and-fixed: docstring now states the insensitivity explicitly and flags the future-check risk.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: genuine wave concurrency, not a call-order artifact
doubts.disproof_attempt: Both worktrees are created/committed sequentially in one process; this proves isolation under sequential composition, not contention-safety under true concurrent runners racing loop.lock.
doubts.resolution: accepted-and-fixed: comment reworded to state the narrower, accurate claim.

doubts.disproof_attempt: All three units are claimed, so only the one-shot swept_never_started path is exercised; the timeout/lease-stale/built-not-merged drain_once branches are untested by this capstone.
doubts.resolution: accepted-and-fixed: comment narrowed to name the exact path exercised.

doubts.disproof_attempt: cmd_finalize and campaign_session_lock never reference each other in code; the ordering is orchestrator prose (campaign-mode.md), not code-enforced.
doubts.resolution: accepted-and-fixed: comment reworded to state the test proves the two subsystems compose without corrupting state, not that ordering itself is gated in code.

summary: 5 objections, all about comments overselling what was verified (no correctness bugs found -- cmd_finalize's TERMINAL-check claim held up under an honest disprove attempt). All 5 addressed by softening/narrowing the relevant comments to the actually-proven claim; re-ran test (1 passed) and lint (clean) after each.
